title: Plus Size Lace Round-Neck Short Sleeve Evening Dress
descriptionHtml:
This plus size formal dress combines a sequin lace bodice with a long flowing skirt for an elegant, flattering look. The round neckline brings a polished touch to the upper body, while the short sleeves provide comfortable coverage. A gently defined waist and soft movement through the skirt make it a lovely option for black tie events, wedding celebrations, and mother of the bride moments.


Tips: Prioritize the bust measurement when selecting, the fabric is highly elastic and can stretch by at least 2 inches. Consider the waist measurement next, and disregard the hip measurement.


Fit: Please refer to size chart.


Length: Maxi.


Sleeve Style: Short sleeves.


Closure: Back zipper.


Undergarments: It is not padded, with lining.


Fabric:The garment comprises lace.


Stretch: Fabric is high stretch.
